title: Stellar XDR conformance corpus manifest (draft)
description: One entry per rare ledger or transaction shape. XDR lives in files next to the manifest; the manifest says where each file came from, which CAP introduced the shape, and what a correct decoder must produce.

id.description: Stable entry ID; also the directory name under entries/.

pattern.description: Scanner tag that selected the entry.

caps.description: CAPs that introduced or changed the shape. Empty for shapes as old as the protocol.

protocol_version.description: Ledger protocol version when the transaction was applied (or the version the generator targeted).

synthetic.description: True when any byte was written by hand or derived by mutation rather than emitted by stellar-core.

derived_from.description: Entry ID a mutation started from.

xdr_type.description: Type name as written in the stellar-xdr .x files.

envelope_sep51_json.description: Path to the SEP-51 XDR-JSON a conforming decoder produces. Written only where rs-stellar-xdr, py-stellar-xdr and js-stellar-sdk agree.

roundtrip.description: Decoding then re-encoding must reproduce the file byte for byte.

stellar_core_decode.description: Verdict of stellar-core's own decoder (print-xdr); the reference for hostile entries.

stellar_core_admission.description: Verdict of stellar-core's protocol-28+ XDR admission parse (rs-stellar-xdr at depth 1000, validateXDRForProtocol); recorded for depth entries.

sightings.description: Public issues or PRs this entry reproduces.
